notes: Panamanian-side counter-archive. Documentary Center holds >150 linear m of books, >32,000 archival folios, and an Archivo de Historia Oral (interviews with protagonistas de la historia de Panamá; UNESCO Memory of the World for the postal collection). Remote use beyond catalog metadata would require an email scan request to the Centro de Documentación or an on-site visit — not yet made. See data/museo/.

notes: The company's petitions to Colombia for 504,200 hectares of 'tierras baldias' (vacant lands) - NONE on the canal line (the sweep registry's 'French line towns' expectation was wrong). The maps refute their own legal category: villages, named smallholder ranchos (M. Gonzales, Florencio Leon, J.B. Torres), an explicit CASERIO INDIO on Punta Bluefield, plantations and the Camino Real are all drawn INSIDE the lots, under 'FORETS VIERGES' lettering. Vacancy-declaration as erasure, 1888 - the mechanism the dissertation tracks in the Zone, a generation early and at territorial scale. Longitudes on the Bogota meridian; stated Escala 1/20.000 on the Bocas sheets (Tucuti scale digit uncertain, ~1/50.000 by graticule span). Out of the study frame: no attestations (PRRLANDS1857 precedent); inventory in TIERRAS1888_features.csv.
